title: 안녕 안녕 아침이야! 몽이와 콩이의 인사 동요

scenes: Mong-i the bunny sits up in a cozy bed, big stretch and a sleepy yawn, warm morning sunlight through the window, tiny sparkles
Kong-i the bear cub wakes up in a leaf-pattern bed, rubs his eyes and then smiles, warm morning light
Both friends at a sunny window waving hello to the rising sun, little birds flying by, joyful
Close-up of both friends beaming big smiles side by side with a gentle bounce, flowers swaying behind them
Both friends facing the camera, waving hands high and bouncing happily to the beat, sparkles in the air, bright meadow
Both friends clapping their hands in rhythm, small hearts popping around them, bouncy cheerful dance
Both friends jumping up and down in place like springs, confetti stars falling, big smiles
Both friends hug, then turn to the camera and wave, rainbow sparkles, joyful ending pose
Bunny and bear cub run toward each other across a green meadow and meet in the middle with a happy hop
They wave both hands and give a cheerful little bow to each other, butterflies around them
They hold hands and swing their arms together, skipping along a flower path
They hold hands and spin in a circle, flower petals swirling, camera slowly orbiting around them
Gentle sunset over the meadow, the sun slowly setting in a pink and orange sky, the two friends sitting on a little hill
The friends wave goodbye on the hill in soft golden light, fireflies appear
The friends walk home yawning softly, tiny stars appearing in the sky, calm gentle walk
The friends wave goodnight from their cozy doorways under a starry sky, big smiles, a shooting star passes
